sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT incidentnum, nibrs_code FROM stg_dallas_police_offenses WHERE nibrs_code = '240' AND EXTRACT(year FROM occurred_date) = 2024) t;

answer.notes: Austin noise request types include several categories; counts are for 2024 only. Noise reporting changed in 2022, but 2024 data is reliable.
sql:
SELECT council_district AS district, COUNT(*) AS complaints
FROM stg_austin_311
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2024
  AND sr_type_desc IN ('APD - Non Emergency Noise/Alarm', 'Loud Commercial Music', 'Zz_Loud Commercial Music', 'DSD - Outdoor Commercial Venue Music Complaint')
GROUP BY council_district
ORDER BY complaints DESC
LIMIT 3;
